title: Analysis code for: Repeated CRP and fibrinogen measurements add no reliable information beyond a single baseline measurement for disability change in adults with arthritis (ELSA)
description: Python analysis code for a negative re-appraisal of repeated inflammatory measurement in the English Longitudinal Study of Ageing. High-sensitivity C-reactive protein and fibrinogen are re-extracted from five nurse-visit tables (2004-2019); participants with doctor-diagnosed arthritis at wave 2 and valid CRP at waves 2, 4 and 6 (n=610; 575 in the primary model) are followed for the rate of change in ADL/IADL disability at waves 7-9. Single-baseline, mean-plus-slope and group-based trajectory models are compared in marginal linear models with cluster-robust standard errors; the primary analysis follows an internally frozen plan; sensitivity analyses cover unknown vital status (upper bound and delta-beta grid), medication adjustment by BNF class, negative controls, bootstrap and permutation calibration, and a two-wave CHARLS direction-consistency check. Includes cohort construction, trajectory models, the design comparison, all sensitivity analyses and figure generation. No respondent-level data are included.
